annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication 'An EU initiative on Web 4.0 and virtual worlds: a head start in the next technological transition'
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication 'An EU initiative on Web 4.0 and virtual worlds: a head start in the next technological transition'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion supporting the Commission's Web 4.0 and virtual worlds initiative. It stresses the social dimension, worker protection, standards and interoperability, sandboxes, sustainability, taxation, and a Charter of Values, and asks whether existing law suffices or new legislation is needed. It does not address physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Assess whether existing legislation suffices for virtual worlds or new legislation is needed
Design a Charter of Values with social partners and civil society
Promote global standards, interoperability and regulatory sandboxes embedding precaution
Address working conditions, health and safety, and law-shopping risks for meta-workers
Clarify the legal status of avatars globally; consider carbon neutrality criteria and taxation
